DKI Jakarta · Solid Waste

Waste Infrastructure Dashboard

Where Jakarta's waste collection reaches — and where it doesn't. Built from the city's own records of collection points, equipment, roads and population. Hover any district for its scorecard, click any point for detail.

Methodology & data sources
Sources: DKI Jakarta open data (collection points, Bank Sampah, public housing, roads, land use), BPS population, WorldPop 2021. Waste volumes follow the Indonesian national standard SNI 8632:2018. Full method and assumptions on the methodology page. Basemap © Esri / OpenStreetMap.
